svg.title: Ходьба на носках с гантелями — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Tiptoe walking carrying two dumbbells, one in EACH hand and arms at sides. Full side three-quarter view, two successive opposite gait phases. In each figure feet staggered front and rear, front foot accepts weight on BALL OF FOOT with heel raised, trailing heel raised and rear toes lifting off. Swap leading foot between phases. Upright posture, not a standing calf raise. Recognizable dumbbells, no platforms. Thin floor line for contact. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
